a: The over-trigger nudge is measured in client px but applied in the overlay frame's px, so a Select under a scale or zoom lands its selected row off the trigger
A placeholder select opened near the bottom edge cannot flip above its trigger
In a right-to-left document the over-trigger crossOffset is computed against the wrong edge
The capture-phase pointerup swallow also hides the opening release from the trigger's own press handling
FitSizer reads a fragment or wrapper child of a children-form Select as one label, so a width='fit' trigger sizes to the sum of the labels
b: `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange` / `selectionMode` reach React Aria and override the kit's key handling
Adding or removing `tooltip`/`shortcut` remounts the trigger button, which drops focus and orphans the held-pick key listener
In an RTL document, the "over" list is shifted sideways by the difference between list and trigger width
On touch, a quick tap on the selected row right after opening is swallowed
`data-align` is never cleared when the over-trigger list loses its selected row while open
Option values `1` and `'1'` get the same React key
